description: Two outlets report an actual Kossou street demonstration on 9 January over water/local infrastructure, but neither gives demonstrator turnout. The 30,000 figure is village population, not participants; >=50 is unknown.
required_followup: Seek a distinct permitted account with site-level simultaneous turnout. Do not infer from village size, barricades or 'population'.

description: JDA reports a Coordisanté general assembly on 14 January, but gives no site, access/publicness or turnout. Search-result copies repeat JDA text and are not independent confirmation.
required_followup: Find a distinct permitted account or venue/union record establishing site, public character, demand and simultaneous size.

description: SYNAFECI announced a sit-in for 19 January over unpaid state invoices; no post-event report or open body verifies that it occurred.
required_followup: Search for a permitted post-event report or dated organizer record; keep pending until execution and attendance are established.

description: The SYNACCI 72-hour strike notice was lifted on 11 January after talks, before the intended 19 January start; planned work stoppage is not evidence of a public protest gathering.
required_followup: No follow-up needed unless credible evidence shows the canceled action nevertheless occurred; do not count the planned stoppage.

description: Opened Kossou reports establish the 9 January action but not an explicit ending, continuation or state response.
required_followup: Only record continuation or closure if later assigned research finds an explicit retrospective or dated activity report.

description: Eighteen searches covered French month discovery, four January date windows, English discovery, regional terms for Abidjan, Bouaké, Yamoussoukro, Korhogo, San Pedro and Daloa, plus health/public-sector unions, suppliers, air transport, water and infrastructure. Open-web coverage was selected, not exhaustive. Lexis/All News and local languages beyond French were not systematically searched.
required_followup: Future bounded research may consult additional local archives/languages and verify pending leads; do not infer no other action occurred.
